Question 3
?

A particle P moves along the x-axis. When the displacement of P from the origin O is x meters, its velocity is vm/s and its acceleration is e−2xm/s2. Which differential equation describes this motion?

a
v2dvdx=e−2x
b
4v2dvdx=e−2x
c
2vdvdx=e−2x
d
vdvdx=e−2x
e
dvdx=e−2x
